flora: Mature Early Redwoods (buttressed trunks, towering height, orange-brown autumn foliage)
Ferns and mosses on the buttressed roots
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; emphasizing the 'buttressed' wide base of the trunks; a misty, humid swamp atmosphere; giant trees making the environment feel ancient and vast.

visual_logic.composition: A wide-angle view of a redwood swamp. The massive trunks have wide, flared bases (buttresses) submerged in shallow, dark water. The foliage is a mix of deep green and rusty ocher, reflected in the still water.
visual_logic.ground: Water-saturated dark mud and silt, with ocher-colored clay visible at the water's edge.
visual_logic.lighting: Soft, diffused light through a humid mist, creating a moody and atmospheric 'swamp forest' feel.
